title: Test scene: What if you woke up 10x stronger? (cold open)

facts.claim: Most adults grip with roughly 30 to 45 kg of force.
facts.source: Dodds et al. 2014, 'Grip strength across the life course: normative data from twelve British studies', PLoS ONE (peak means ~51 kg men, ~31 kg women).

lines.text: It's 7:02 a.m. Your alarm goes off, so you smack the snooze button.
Your hand goes straight through the nightstand.
You sit up. The bed frame snaps like a breadstick.
Here's the thing. Most adults squeeze with about 30 to 45 kilograms of force.
And that's when it gets weird.
